sql.statement: WITH "__antfly_series_selected" AS (SELECT jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id') AS "attrs.device_id", jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') AS "attrs.region", COUNT(*) AS "__antfly_series_documents" FROM "fixture" AS "__antfly_series_source" WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime >= $1::datetime AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime < $2::datetime AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') = $5 AND NOT is_missing(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id')) AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id') IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_missing(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region')) AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id'), jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, concat('[', COALESCE(to_jsonb(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id'))::text, 'null'), ',', COALESCE(to_jsonb(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region'))::text, 'null'), ']') ASC LIMIT $6) SELECT jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id') AS "attrs.device_id", jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') AS "attrs.region", date_bin($3, jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime, $4::datetime) AS "bucket", AVG((jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'temperature'))::double precision) AS "average", SUM((jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'temperature'))::double precision) AS "total", COUNT(*) AS "readings" FROM "fixture" AS "__antfly_series_source" JOIN "__antfly_series_selected" ON jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "__antfly_series_selected"."attrs.device_id" AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "__antfly_series_selected"."attrs.region" WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime >= $1::datetime AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime < $2::datetime AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') = $5 AND NOT is_missing(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id')) AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id') IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_missing(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region')) AND jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id'), jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region'), date_bin($3, jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime, $4::datetime), "__antfly_series_selected"."__antfly_series_documents" ORDER BY "__antfly_series_selected"."__antfly_series_documents" DESC, concat('[', COALESCE(to_jsonb(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'device_id'))::text, 'null'), ',', COALESCE(to_jsonb(jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'region'))::text, 'null'), ']') ASC, date_bin($3, jsonb_extract_path_text("__antfly_series_source"."attrs", 'observed_at')::datetime, $4::datetime)
